description: This Java test class validates the behavior of the LongValueValidator class, focusing on its immutability, null handling, validation logic for long values, and handling of invalid inputs.

classes.name: LongValueValidatorTest
classes.description: A unit test class for the LongValueValidator, verifying its validation logic, immutability, and handling of null and invalid inputs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, mocking HeaderDefinition responses and creating an instance of LongValueValidator.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that LongValueValidator instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Verifies that passing a null header definition throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that accepting a null value throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException with a message indicating invalid input.

methods.name: canValidateLong
methods.description: Checks that Long and long Java types are accepted for validation by the validator.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that a valid long string does not throw exceptions upon acceptance.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotLong
methods.description: Ensures that accepting a value with a non-long Java type is handled gracefully without exceptions.

methods.name: acceptInvalidCharSequence
methods.description: Checks that an invalid string not representing a long throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException.
